title: 음악을 들으면서 운동해요: 두 가지 일을 같이 할 때
objective: By the end, you can make the -(으)면서 form of regular verbs, ㄹ-stems and ㄷ-irregular verbs, and use it correctly with the same subject and with the tense on the last verb.
summary: Learn to use -(으)면서 to say that one person does two things at the same time.

task.title: Use -(으)면서 correctly
task.line: Make the right form, fill in the blank, join or check the sentences, and answer in Korean.

forms.when: The verb stem ends in a vowel (보다, 마시다, 공부하다).
forms.means: doing A while doing B (the same person, at the same time)
forms.example: 저는 보통 뉴스를 보면서 아침을 먹어요.
forms.exampleMeaning: I usually eat breakfast while watching the news.

forms.when: The stem ends in ㄹ (만들다, 살다). Just add -면서. Do not add 으.
forms.exampleMeaning: Dad talked while he was making gimbap.

forms.when: The stem ends in a consonant other than ㄹ (읽다, 웃다, 앉다). Irregular verbs change their stem first: ㄷ-irregular (see below), ㅂ-irregular (돕다 → 도우면서), ㅅ-irregular (짓다 → 지으면서).
forms.exampleMeaning: The teacher said hello with a smile.

forms.when: Verbs like 듣다 and 걷다. The ㄷ changes to ㄹ, and then 으 is added.
forms.exampleMeaning: I work out while listening to music.

watchOut: 듣면서 (X) → 들으면서 (O): 듣다 and 걷다 change ㄷ to ㄹ, and then 으 is added.
만들으면서 (X) → 만들면서 (O): ㄹ-stems take only -면서, with no 으.
제가 요리하면서 친구가 설거지해요 (X) → 저는 요리하고 친구는 설거지해요 (O): one person must do both actions. If two people do them, use -고.
밥을 먹었으면서 TV를 봤어요 (X) → 밥을 먹으면서 TV를 봤어요 (O): put the past tense only on the last verb.
exercises: Write the -(으)면서 form: ① 마시다 ② 놀다 ③ 찾다
Fill in the blank with 걷다: 저는 매일 저녁 한강 공원을 ____ 친구하고 통화해요.
Join the two sentences into one with -(으)면서: 친구가 피아노를 쳤어요. 친구가 노래를 불렀어요.
Is the sentence correct? Write O or X: ① 형은 샤워하면서 노래를 불러요. ② 제가 설거지하면서 동생이 방을 청소했어요. ③ 저는 어제 밥을 했으면서 빨래를 했어요. ④ 우리는 차를 마시면서 이야기했어요.
Answer in Korean with -(으)면서 and the words given: 주말에 보통 뭐 하면서 쉬어요? (과자를 먹다)
answers: ① 마시면서 ② 놀면서 ③ 찾으면서
친구가 피아노를 치면서 노래를 불렀어요. (친구가 노래를 부르면서 피아노를 쳤어요.)
① O ② X ③ X ④ O
